project_name.justification: The article describes an agreement to acquire claims next to the company's 'flagship Corner Bay high-grade copper deposit'.

company_name.justification: The acquiring company is identified as: 'Doré Copper Mining Corp. (the "Company" or "Doré Copper") (TSXV: DCMC; OTCQB: DRCMF; FRA: DCM)'.

ceo_buyer.justification: The text identifies the CEO of the buyer, Dore Copper: 'Ernest Mast, President and CEO of Doré Copper, commented...'

interest_acquired_percent.justification: The company entered into an agreement 'to acquire a 56.41% interest in a group of contiguous claims (the “Claim Group”)'.

primary_commodity.justification: The project is described as the 'flagship Corner Bay high-grade copper project'.

verified_article_link.justification: The provided text is a news release but does not contain a usable URL.

currency.justification: The payments are denominated in '$' and the acquiring company is listed on the TSX Venture Exchange (TSXV: DCMC) and is subject to 'applicable Canadian securities legislation', implying Canadian Dollars (CAD).

cash_payments_raw.justification: The total cash consideration is $370,000, which includes an upfront payment and two future contingent payments. The text states: 'a cash payment of $20,000', 'the Company will pay SOQUEM the sum of $100,000', and 'the Company will pay SOQUEM the sum of $250,000'.

share_payments_raw.justification: The agreement states that upon execution, 'SOQUEM is to receive... (ii) equivalent of $125,000 in common shares of the Company'.

cash_and_share_payments_combined_raw.justification: Separate values for cash and share payments were provided in the text.

amount_of_shares_issued.justification: The value of the share payment was provided in dollars ('equivalent of $125,000 in common shares'), not as a specific number of shares.

share_warrant_payments_raw.justification: No share warrants were mentioned as part of the transaction terms.

option_payments_raw.justification: No options were mentioned as part of the transaction terms.

issued_share_price.justification: The number of shares to be issued was not specified, so a price per share for the transaction cannot be determined.

exploration_commitment_meters.justification: The agreement does not include an exploration commitment defined by drilling meters.

exploration_commitment_value_raw.justification: The agreement does not include a monetary exploration spending commitment.

nsr_acquired_percent.justification: The seller, SOQUEM, will retain a 1% NSR as part of the consideration. The text states: 'On commencement of commercial production... the Company will pay SOQUEM the sum of $250,000 and a 1% Net Smelter Return royalty (the "NSR") on the production of copper and gold.'

coverage_area_raw.justification: The acquired claims cover a specified area: 'The Claim Group totals 17 claims covering an area of 446 ha'.

coverage_area_unit.justification: The unit for the coverage area is specified as hectares: 'The Claim Group totals 17 claims covering an area of 446 ha'.

resource_size.justification: The text does not provide a current mineral resource estimate for the acquired Claim Group. A future payment is contingent on completing one, which implies none currently exists: 'in the event that the Company completes a mineral resource estimate in accordance with NI 43-101 on the Claim Group, the Company will pay SOQUEM the sum of $100,000.'

buyer_ticker_and_exchange.justification: The buyer's ticker and exchange are explicitly stated in the text: 'Doré Copper Mining Corp. (the "Company" or "Doré Copper") (TSXV: DCMC; OTCQB: DRCMF; FRA: DCM)'.
